mintAuthority.summary: eurSPKCC mint is gated by a Spiko PermissionManager on every chain. On Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum and Base the token's mint selector accepts group 0 (a 3/8 Safe on Ethereum, 3/6 elsewhere) or group 2, whose members are Spiko's two-step Minter contract (5,000,000 eurSPKCC daily limit, initiator + approver) and the Chainlink CCIP BurnWithFromMintTokenPool, itself owned by an EOA. Starknet mint requires MINTER_ROLE, held by a 3/5 Argent multisig plus three single-key accounts. Stellar mint requires the MINTER role, held by three single-key accounts, and the owner is a single-key account that can upgrade the wasm. Cross-chain the Safe-gated EVM admin is the bound; Starknet and Stellar are single-key surfaces.

controls.label: eurSPKCC token restricted mint (ethereum)
controls.capDescription: mint(address,uint256) has no supply cap; access is gated only by PermissionManager group membership.
controls.evidence: At ethereum block 25530961: token owner() = 0x0, authority() = 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472, EIP-1967 admin slot = 0x0 (UUPS). PermissionManager.getRequirements(token, 0x40c10f19 mint) = groups {0, 2}; getRequirements(token, 0x9dc29fac burn) = groups {0, 4}. No cap variable exists in the implementation ABI.

controls.label: Spiko PermissionManager admin group Safe (ethereum)
controls.capDescription: Group 0 satisfies the token mint requirement mask directly and can addGroup any address into the minter group; it also sets the Minter daily limit.
controls.evidence: At ethereum block 25530961: PermissionManager 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472 getGroups(0x4eaa52b6280593a8820c45ce38f974290ae52cea) = {0 (ADMIN), 255 (PUBLIC)}; Safe getThreshold()/getOwners() = 3/8, VERSION 1.4.1. getRequirements(PermissionManager, addGroup / setRequirements / setGroupAdmins / upgradeToAndCall) = group {0}; getRequirements(token, upgradeToAndCall) = group {0}. canCall(0x4eaa52b6280593a8820c45ce38f974290ae52cea, token, 0x40c10f19) = true.

controls.label: Spiko two-step Minter with daily limit (ethereum)
controls.capDescription: dailyLimit(eurSPKCC) = 500000000000 base units (5,000,000 eurSPKCC at 5 decimals) per rolling day; only the group-0 admin Safe can call setDailyLimit.
controls.evidence: At ethereum block 25530961: Minter proxy 0x5ed5a75eeed1934ea060186e35187eaa73331366 is a UUPS ERC-1967 proxy (admin slot 0x0) and is in PermissionManager group 2, so canCall(minter, token, mint) = true. Verified implementation ("Minter") exposes initiateMint/approveMint/cancelMint (restricted) plus dailyLimit/getMintedToday. dailyLimit(eurSPKCC) = 500000000000, getMintedToday = 0, maxDelay = 86400s. getRequirements(minter, initiateMint) = group {0, 10}; approveMint = {0, 9}; setDailyLimit = {0}.

controls.label: Spiko CCIP token-pool owner EOA (deployment-wide)
controls.capDescription: Owner of every eurSPKCC CCIP pool on Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum and Base; can applyChainUpdates (add remote lanes/pools) and setChainRateLimiterConfig, i.e. can widen or remove the bridge-mint bound.
controls.evidence: Ethereum block 25530961: owner() of the eurSPKCC pool 0x57fa613b284f05421f78c8bd579555d5c0d7783d (and of the EUTBL/USTBL/UKTBL/SPKCC pools, and of the corresponding pools on Polygon, Arbitrum and Base) = 0xEd608cf38968C0ba09676843D90B33Dd59dd7375, an EOA (getCode = 0x). Its recorded calls to the pool are applyChainUpdates and setChainRateLimiterConfig. It was PermissionManager group 0 at deployment and was removed from group 0 in the same transaction batch (block 19690268).

controls.label: eurSPKCC Starknet token role-gated mint
controls.capDescription: mint has no cap; it asserts MINTER_ROLE on the caller and WHITELISTED_ROLE on the recipient via the Starknet PermissionManager.
controls.evidence: Starknet block 11841234: class 0x5973b1bed1f0a20a9125fac8ec5499f29f44bb70d9c465658c0da20ca9b75f3 (OZ ERC20 + OwnableTwoStep + Upgradeable + Pausable, plus mint/burn/redeem and set_permission_manager_contract_address). Storage var permission_manager_contract_address = 0x7c7a6db2763d01aa889702bf5eb7b88a01a9df11da0e3d45c96a140c1f43ba3. total_supply() = 0. starknet_simulateTransactions of mint reverted with "Wrong role: role should be 0x29d542926e6695b59ac6fbdcd9b37e8b1aeb757afab06ab60b1bb5878c3b49" = sn_keccak("WHITELISTED_ROLE") on the recipient, proving the PermissionManager role gate.

controls.label: Spiko Starknet PermissionManager (AccessControl)
controls.capDescription: OZ Cairo AccessControl; get_role_admin(MINTER_ROLE) = DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, so the DEFAULT_ADMIN holder can grant MINTER_ROLE to any account without limit.
controls.evidence: Starknet block 11841135: class 0x425da7d8656a0e31d1801af829993bce3689a845934e78ca449f1bbadb52ccf exposes IAccessControl (has_role/grant_role/revoke_role/get_role_admin) and IUpgradeable. get_role_admin(sn_keccak("MINTER_ROLE") = 0x32df0fed2c77648de5860a4cc508cd0818c85b8b8a1ab4ceeef8d981c8956a6) = 0x0 (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE). Full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked scan (blocks 930000 to head, Lava + Cartridge RPC) returns exactly four MINTER_ROLE grants and no revocations; has_role confirms all four still hold it.

controls.label: Spiko Starknet owner Argent multisig (3/5)
controls.capDescription: Holds MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, owns the token (can upgrade the class and swap the PermissionManager). Unbounded.
controls.evidence: Starknet block 11841234: token owner() = 0x7bc8bbd7...5ca9d; that account's class 0x6e150953b26271a740bf2b6e9bca17cc52c68d765f761295de51ceb8526ee72 reports get_name() = "ArgentMultisig", get_threshold() = 3, get_signers() = 5 keys. It holds MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (has_role = 1 at block 11841135). Simulated calls (SKIP_VALIDATE) from this account succeed for upgrade, pause and set_permission_manager_contract_address, and fail for mint only on the recipient WHITELISTED_ROLE check.

controls.label: Starknet MINTER_ROLE single-key accounts (3)

controls.evidence: Starknet block 11841234: has_role(MINTER_ROLE, x) = 1 for 0x2d5ad99f... (single-key account, get_public_key = 0x2ae0b200...), 0x295afc14... and 0x14fc1fa3... A simulateTransaction of mint from a MINTER holder passes the has_role(caller, MINTER) check and then calls has_role(recipient, WLISTED), which proves the gate.

review.evidence: Every chain in the coin file was read on-chain. EVM (Ethereum 25530961, Polygon 90218705, Arbitrum 483768450, Base 48621853): PermissionManager.getRequirements(token, mint) = groups {0,2} on all four; group membership enumerated from the complete GroupAdded/GroupRemoved log history (Blockscout etherscan-compatible logs API) and every candidate re-checked with getGroups() at head. Group 0 = Spiko admin Safe (3/8 on Ethereum, 3/6 on Polygon/Arbitrum/Base, all Safe v1.4.1, no modules, no guard); group 2 = the Spiko Minter proxy (dailyLimit 500000000000, initiator group 10 + approver group 9) and the Chainlink CCIP BurnWithFromMintTokenPool for each Spiko fund token, all owned by EOA 0xEd608cf3.... Starknet (block 11841234): MINTER_ROLE holders enumerated from a full RoleGranted/RoleRevoked scan and confirmed with has_role — a 3/5 ArgentMultisig plus three single-key accounts. Stellar (Soroban ledger 63473407): the PermissionManager is enumerable, get_role_member(MINTER, 0..2) returns three accounts, and Horizon shows all three plus the owner/admin are single-signer accounts. Upgradeability: all four EVM token proxies are UUPS (EIP-1967 admin slot = 0x0) and getRequirements(token, upgradeToAndCall) = group {0}, so the admin Safe can replace mint logic; Ethereum/Polygon/Base share implementation 0x15ea0ec4..., Arbitrum runs 0xa0769f7a...; the Starknet class is OZ-Upgradeable and owner-gated (simulated upgrade from the 3/5 Argent multisig succeeds) and the Soroban wasm upgrade is owner-gated to single-key account GBYIQXBK... (simulated upgrade succeeds for the owner, fails for a MINTER holder). The open question about the non-Ethereum deployments is resolved and removed. Evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15: the official product page identifies CACEIS as depositary and accountant and states that PwC performs recurring statutory audits, but it still showed allocation data last updated 2025-11-21 and exposed no dated PwC report or other current independent supply-to-assets reconciliation. Those role and cadence claims do not establish a qualifying recurring report, so reconciliation remains unknown. The exact AMF GECO registry evidence is retained in the sources, but supervision is intentionally not authored while reconciliation evidence is absent. Reconciliation review (2026-08-08): same fund as SPKCC, EUR share class (ISIN FR0014010ON7). The prospectus supersedes the product-page claims the 2026-07-15 pass could not qualify: CACEIS Fund Administration is the delegated accounting agent striking the NAV daily on a D+1 basis, CACEIS Bank is the ACPR-authorised depositary, and PricewaterhouseCoopers Audit is statutory auditor. Supervision is prudential through the AMF-authorised manager Twenty First Capital SAS (GP-11000029) and the ACPR-authorised depositary rather than through the fund vehicle, which the prospectus states is not AMF-authorised.
